title: SPARC Cat - Sham Control Chronic Cat 3, Day 14
author: Brett Hanzlicek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfzpjp5n
materials: Transport cat from housing site to surgery site.

steps.title: Prepare Animal for Surgery
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the cat, shave the abdomen, and move the animal to the surgery room to be attached to monitors by the vet team.

steps.title: Sterilize Surgical Site
steps.instruction: Drape the animal and perform a betadine scrub on the abdomen and genitals.

steps.title: Insert Bladder Catheter
steps.instruction: Insert a 3.5Fr catheter into the bladder through the urethra using surgilube.

substeps.instruction: Advance the catheter until resistance is met

steps.title: Collect Urine Sample
steps.instruction: Withdraw urine from the bladder through the catheter using gentle suction with a syringe.

substeps.instruction: Measure the volume and save the urine for urinalysis

steps.title: Perform Contrast CT Imaging
steps.instruction: Visualize the bladder using a 1:5 dilution of contrast to saline.

substeps.instruction: Fill the bladder with 10 mL contrast and take a single CT image
Add 10 mL more contrast to the bladder (total of 20 mL) and take a single CT image
Take a 3D CT image with 20 mL contrast:saline in the bladder

steps.title: Set Up Urodynamics Equipment
steps.instruction: Transfer the cat from Isoflurane to propofol anesthetic and configure the pressure recording system.

substeps.instruction: Connect an external pressure transducer to a syringe pump on one end and tubing leading to the catheter on the other
Set up Labview software to record data
Set the syringe pump fill rate to 2 mL saline/minute

steps.title: Perform Urodynamics Round 1
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline and record pressure using the pressure transducer and LabView.

substeps.instruction: Tug on the catheter after filling to visualize contraction in Labview software

steps.title: Perform Urodynamics Round 2
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline at a rate of 2 mL/min.

steps.title: Post-Procedure Recovery
steps.instruction: Wait for the cat to wake up and return it to the housing site.
